description: Complete Journey toilet-tissue coupon campaign 18. All-household category sales were USD 5669.07 in weeks 45–52 versus USD 5221.50 in weeks 37–44. Matched category redemptions were 8 versus 2 (+6, +300.0%).

mechanics.depth_basis: Ratios of summed USD amounts on positive-quantity tissue purchase lines in weeks 45–52. Regular shelf value = sales_value + abs(retail_disc) + abs(coupon_match_disc). Shelf markdown = abs(retail_disc). Coupon markdown = abs(coupon_disc) paid by the manufacturer + abs(coupon_match_disc) paid by the retailer only upon coupon use. The two depths add on the same shelf denominator. Retailer sales_value includes manufacturer reimbursement.
mechanics.scope: All tissue purchases include regular-price lines and overlapping promotions. Only matched lines join a campaign 18 redemption by an assigned household to a coupon-discounted eligible SKU purchased that day, counting each transaction line once. Matched depths describe realized redemptions. The existing discount_depth remains the median combined line depth on those purchases.
mechanics.shelf_reach_basis: Default availability to all shoppers at a qualifying shelf. Actual store visits and shelf impressions are unobserved.

observed_redemption_rate_note: use to validate, not as reach input

seasonality_control.method: Difference-in-differences in percentage points. Subtract the unweighted mean control-category sales change from the toilet-tissue sales change. Each change compares total retailer sales including returns in the same eight-week windows. The reported range spans the mean-adjusted and median-adjusted lifts.
seasonality_control.selection: Household paper and hygiene product types in GROCERY with zero campaign-18 coupon-eligible products.

naive_benchmark.method: Equal-weight mean of other toilet-tissue coupon campaign lifts wholly in weeks 1–44, or zero if none qualify. For each, compare mean weekly net retailer sales in complete active weeks against the eight complete weeks before launch. Subtract the unweighted mean percentage change of the holdout controls without coupons in that campaign. Round only the final benchmark to two decimal places.
